headline: TSMC is reportedly working with partners to expand supply of the larger photomasks needed for next-generation High NA EUV chipmaking.
score_reason: Supply-chain step for a future lithography generation; article blocked and no other outlet found, so unverified.
importance_line: Larger photomasks, the patterned plates that print circuits onto wafers, could help bring ASML's High NA EUV machines into volume production of future chips, if the report holds.
summary: Quartz reports that TSMC is working with partners to expand supply of large-format photomasks for High NA EUV, the next generation of extreme ultraviolet lithography, the chipmaking tools made by ASML.
notes: qz.com returned HTTP 403 twice; Google News RSS searches on photomask, High NA EUV and the exact phrase found no other outlet, and Quartz's RSS feed does not list the piece. Headline only; score lowered from 5 to 4.
